workshoptitle: Implementing Semantic Search in APEX Apps

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Overview of semantic search in Oracle APEX applications.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Search Configuration and Vector Providers
tutorials.description: Configure the database privilege, load the ONNX embedding model, and validate the APEX vector provider.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Enable Vector Embeddings on the Candidates Table
tutorials.description: Add semantic search columns, generate vector embeddings, and validate ranking behavior.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Implement Semantic Search on the Candidate Pipeline in TAP
tutorials.description: Create the vector search configuration and add semantic candidate search to TAP.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Build the HR Policy Search Page in ESS
tutorials.description: Generate embeddings for HR policy content and create a semantic search page in ESS.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
